research_loops.cluster_name: The Non-Deterministic Observability Gap: Why Classical APM (RED/USE) Fails for Agents

rounds.topic: The Fundamental Failure of Classical APM (RED/USE) for GenAI Agents
rounds.finding: Classical APM metrics (Rate, Errors, Duration) monitor HTTP status codes and CPU load but completely miss semantic failures where an agent outputs factually wrong answers with HTTP 200 OK.

rounds.topic: Non-Deterministic Execution Paths and Divergent Trajectories

rounds.topic: Measuring Thought Quality: In-Flight Cognitive Health Signals
rounds.finding: Tracking metrics like token perplexity, repetition frequency, and tool argument variance provides early warning indicators of agent reasoning degradation.

rounds.topic: Cost Blindness: The Hidden Financial Liability of Recursive Loops
rounds.finding: A microservice retry loop burning $10 in CPU time is negligible; an unmonitored recursive agent loop burning $10,000 in frontier LLM tokens bankrupts departmental budgets.

rounds.topic: The Three Pillars of AgentOps: Trajectory, Cost, and Accuracy
rounds.finding: Production AgentOps unifies distributed tracing (trajectory), granular financial accounting (cost), and automated rubric evaluation (accuracy) into a single plane.

rounds.topic: Instrumentation Overhead vs Telemetry Resolution Tradeoffs
rounds.finding: Emitting full prompt and completion payloads on every reasoning step generates multi-terabyte log volumes, requiring intelligent sampling on successful executions.

rounds.topic: Context Window Saturation as an Operational Health Metric
rounds.finding: Monitoring working context utilization percentage alerts operators when agents approach context limits, preempting lost-in-the-middle degradation.

rounds.topic: Detecting Stalled Reasoning vs Legitimate Deep Thinking
rounds.finding: Distinguishing between an agent stuck in an infinite reasoning loop and an agent performing deep multi-turn synthesis requires tracking novel token generation rates.

rounds.topic: Establishing SRE Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for Non-Deterministic Agents
rounds.finding: Modern AgentOps defines SLOs around Task Completion Rate (>95%), Cost Per Completed Task (<$0.15), and P95 End-to-End Latency (<4.5s).

rounds.finding: Standardizing error codes across OpenAI, Anthropic, and local vLLM runtimes into unified OpenTelemetry exception events simplifies incident triage.

rounds.finding: Adopting standard OTel semantic conventions prevents vendor lock-in, enabling organizations to switch telemetry storage backends with zero code changes.
